CookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
CookiePolicy.intro: This page explains what cookies Naafi Travels uses and why, in plain terms.
CookiePolicy.necessaryBody: We use a single, strictly necessary session cookie to keep you logged in and remember your in-progress search or booking. It's a first-party cookie (not third-party), can't be turned off without losing the ability to use the site, and lasts 30 minutes if you're not logged in, or 30 days if you are.
CookiePolicy.paymentBody: At the payment step, our payment processor (Stripe) may set its own cookies for fraud prevention. We don't control these directly - see Stripe's privacy policy for details.
CookiePolicy.preferenceBody: Your choice on the cookie notice is stored in your browser's local storage (localStorage), not a cookie, and stays only on your device.
CookiePolicy.noAnalyticsBody: We don't currently use any analytics, advertising, or social media cookies. If we add any in the future, we'll update this page and ask for your consent before turning them on.
